fields: h, stages (or items) [{t, d, spot | icon, label, fx}]. label: a short stop name for the mono code ("Feed", "RO 1"; default the first word of t). fx: "gas" draws a few rising bubbles over that stop. optional: true (or the word to show, a string) marks a stage fitted only on some systems (DR-018 rule 2: optional equipment is never drawn as standard): its stop is drawn dashed (node ring, and the phone bend) and its mono code carries "Where fitted" (or the given word) after the label; the class is-optional is set on the stop.
best_for: WindingRoute draws a treatment train as one winding pipe across a navy band, each stage a stop on the wave with its line glyph, so the reader follows the water stage by stage.

block.intro: The skid starts at the RO permeate connection and ends at the storage inlet. Sample points: set in your design.

stages.label: Feed
stages.d: Arrives from the RO skid at [RO permeate conductivity, µS/cm], low enough for EDI.

stages.label: EDI
stages.d: A direct current drives the remaining ions through membranes into a concentrate stream. The resin in the dilute cells keeps working without regeneration chemicals.

stages.label: Reject
stages.d: Recycled to the RO feed or sent to drain, set in your design.

stages.label: Out
stages.d: Water out of specification does not reach storage: it goes to a route set in your design until it recovers.

block.intro: Water passes the four stages in a fixed order. Three 3/4 in garden-hose connections: feed, product and concentrate.

stages.label: In
stages.d: A hose tap on a mains supply at 2.8 to 5.5 bar (40 to 80 psi); a pressure regulator above that.
5 µm, in a 10 × 2.5 in housing. Changed on pressure drop.
10 × 4.5 in housing. Removes chlorine and chloramine, which would damage the membrane.
One 4040 element in a 304 stainless steel housing. Concentrate leaves through a fixed 1.6 mm orifice, always open, with a ball valve to set recovery and flush.
10 × 4.5 in housing. Design target: 0 ppm TDS reading at the outlet while the resin has capacity.

stages.label: Out
stages.d: Low-mineral water, checked with a handheld TDS meter.

block.intro: Air in, drinking water at the dispenser. Production rises with warm, humid air and falls with dry or cold air.

stages.label: Air
stages.d: A MERV 13 filter cleans the air drawn in.

stages.label: Cool
stages.d: The air is cooled below its dew point and its moisture condenses.

stages.label: Filter
stages.d: Four filtration stages, then a mineralizer for taste.

stages.label: UV
stages.d: Ultraviolet light sterilizes the water before storage.

stages.label: Out
stages.d: 1.8 US gal (6.8 L) internal storage; the dispenser delivers 1 US gal/min (3.8 L/min).
